human_priority_contract.protected_outcome: A future operator can reconstruct which event facts are known, what evidence is missing, which current-source basis supported time-sensitive actions, whether a watch failed, and which external actions lack authority without relying on the original creator or implementation.
must_preserve: evidence gaps instead of false completeness
decision-time official-source observation identity and digest
watch degradation instead of silent no-change
must_not_require: the original Event Assist binder implementation
an RTS-owned database, scheduler, retriever, storage engine, crypto engine, or submission engine

known_death_causes: evidence gap present while aggregate case falsely PASSed
declared-current official source remained trusted beyond declared stale_after
verified deadline pin had no current official source
verified user-specific legal pin ignored UNKNOWN applicability fact
required action authority was BLOCKED while aggregate case still PASSed
past deadline was not surfaced as OVERDUE
mutable official URL lacked a decision-time observed artifact digest
regeneration_procedure: Start from this packet and canonical JSON material, not chat memory.
Use any current JSON-capable tool or language; the original Python occupant is optional.
Apply regeneration_rules to produce the protected blocking-state projection.
Preserve evidence gaps, watch failures, overdue deadlines, and missing required authority as visible states.
Do not infer submission or promotion authority from document readiness or from successful reconstruction.
Replay the frozen workload and inherited known_death_causes.
Record PASS, FAIL, or UNKNOWN plus the replacement identity and lineage transition.
unknowns: This packet proves one material frame only; it does not prove creator-independent regeneration of every future RTS frame.
External provider/device/administrative independence remains an operational-evidence question where declared material.
